content.text: {"headline":"Approve P1: no-cost breaks, cross-skilled move and callback lifts the disruption window to 90.6% against the 80% target","why":"This is an outage. P1 incident INC-20261009-3059 (card authorisation gateway declining debit cards) pushed Payments calls to 212 against 108.7 forecast. Most of the excess is card_declined calls (164 vs 61.5 expected). Service level fell to 2.4% and 83 callers hung up. P1 delays breaks, moves 4 cross-skilled agents from General to Payments from 13:00 to 15:00, adds IVR callback, and plays an outage message for card_declined. For 12:45-14:45 it predicts 90.6% service level overall (Payments 95.1%, General 83.2%) and 1.6% abandons, at zero extra cost and with no policy violations. Rest of day is predicted at 92.9%.","trade_offs":["No action (P0) is also predicted to reach the target at 88.5%, but P1 does better on Payments (95.1% vs 88.3%) and abandons (1.6% vs 2.1%), also at no cost.","General drops to 83.2% under P1, compared with 88.9% if nothing is done. That is still above target, but the other queue absorbs the move.","P3 performs best (95.6%, General 93.5%, 0.8% abandons) but costs INR 3,492 in overtime.","P2 costs INR 252 and comes in lower at 88.2%. P4 costs INR 1,620 and breaks policy MOV-03, with General predicted at 69% against the 70% floor."],"watch":"Watch General service level while the 4 agents are moved; it is predicted at 83.2%, so check it stays well above the 70% floor. Also watch card_declined volume and the incident status. If the outage runs past 15:00 or volume climbs further, consider the P3 overtime."}
